request.auth: Supabase session required (same middleware chain as /api/chat); unauthenticated returns 401 envelope

body_fields.query: string, required, 1..4000 chars after trim; longer input rejected with input_invalid envelope
body_fields.conversation_window: optional array of prior turns, max 6, role+content only; used for guardrail context, never as authority
body_fields.as_of_date: optional ISO date string; defaults to request date; forwarded verbatim to the adapter
body_fields.trace_id: optional client-supplied UUID; server generates one when absent and echoes it in every envelope

request.rejected_fields: unknown top-level fields cause input_invalid (fail closed on shape drift, C1)

kinds.rule: only emitted when every guardrail stage passed and citations verified against the adapter (C6, C7)
refusal_message drawn only from refusal-templates.json entries (owner review P6); never model-generated free text
internal failures never leak stack traces, adapter internals, or partial answers; audit write failure converts the whole response to error (fail-closed audit, C12)

route_pipeline_order: 2 bootValidate cached result check (environment.ts); invalid target = error envelope, no processing
3 pre-retrieval guardrails GP-1..GP-9 (guardrail.ts); trip = refusal envelope + refusal record
4 adapter.lookupAliases + adapter.searchChunks via LegalRetrievalAdapter interface only
5 post-retrieval guardrails GQ-1..GQ-5; empty or fully-gated result = refusal
6 prompt assembly (prompt-contract.ts) from adapter metadata envelopes only
7 model call via model-client.ts injected factory (mock in M1)
8 post-generation guardrails GA-1..GA-4 incl. citation verification (citation-verifier.ts)
9 audit writes (audit-logger.ts) then envelope emit; write failure = error envelope

injection_seams.adapter: createRetrievalAdapter() factory resolved from environment target; M1 resolves mock only; type enum has no production member
injection_seams.model: createModelClient() factory; tests inject deterministic mock
injection_seams.audit: createAuditLogger() factory; M1 resolves mock sink
injection_seams.clock: as_of_date passthrough keeps route pure for tests

hard_prohibitions_in_route: no supabase client import anywhere in the qa-research module graph (static test enforced)
no import of legal-corpus-data.json or loadRelevantCorpus pattern
no general legal knowledge fallback: model prompt forbids answering beyond supplied envelopes and GA checks enforce it
